auto_translation:
The One who called Abram
and established covenant
does not turn away from my tears.
final_translation:
The One who called Abram
and established covenant
does not turn away from my tears.

stt_text: 홍해 앞에서 자기 백성의 부르짖음을 들으신 하나님이 지금도 자기 백성의 신음을 모른 척하지 않으십니다.
auto_translation:
The God who heard His people's cry at the Red Sea
still does not ignore the groaning of His people today.
final_translation:
The God who heard His people's cry at the Red Sea
still does not ignore the groaning of His people today.

auto_translation: The problem has not disappeared.
final_translation: The problem has not disappeared.

auto_translation: The suffering has not ended either.
final_translation: The suffering has not ended either.

stt_text: 그런데 이제는 그 현실을 하나님 없는 어둠 속에 버려진 현실로만 읽지 않게 됩니다.
auto_translation: But now, we no longer read that reality only as one abandoned in darkness without God.
final_translation: But now, we no longer read that reality only as one abandoned in darkness without God.

stt_text: 더 정확하게 말하면, 이 공동체는 이제 자기 현실을 더 이상 감추지 않게 됩니다.
auto_translation: More precisely, this community no longer hides its reality anymore.
final_translation: More precisely, this community no longer hides its reality anymore.

stt_text: 그러니 이 공동체 안에 변화가 일어납니다.
auto_translation: So change takes place within this community.
final_translation: So change takes place within this community.

stt_text: 하나님을 보지 못한 상태에서의 회개는 정죄로 흐르기 쉽습니다.
auto_translation: When we are in a state of not seeing God, repentance can easily turn into condemnation.
final_translation: When we are in a state of not seeing God, repentance can easily turn into condemnation.

stt_text: 반대로 죄를 가볍게 여기고 대충 덮어 버릴 수도 있습니다.
auto_translation:
On the other hand, we may take sin lightly
and just cover it over carelessly.
final_translation:
On the other hand, we may take sin lightly
and just cover it over carelessly.

stt_text: 하지만 말씀 앞에서 하나님을 다시 본 뒤의 회개는 다릅니다.
auto_translation: But repentance is different after seeing God again before the Word.
final_translation: But repentance is different after seeing God again before the Word.

stt_text: 그 회개는 단지 감정의 폭발이 아니라, 하나님 앞에서 자기 현실을 숨기지 않고 가져오는 것이 됩니다.
auto_translation:
That repentance is not merely an outburst of emotion. 
It becomes bringing your reality before God without hiding it.
final_translation:
That repentance is not merely an outburst of emotion. 
It becomes bringing your reality before God without hiding it.

stt_text: 성도 여러분, 그래서 먼저 해야 할 일은 문제를 오래 붙드는 것이 아닙니다.
auto_translation: Brothers and sisters, the first thing we must do is not to hold on to the problem for a long time.
final_translation: Brothers and sisters, the first thing we must do is not to hold on to the problem for a long time.

stt_text: 두려움이 내 현실을 이끌도록 두지 마십시오.
auto_translation: Do not let fear direct my reality.
final_translation: Do not let fear direct my reality.

stt_text: 그 문제를 다루시는 하나님 앞에 오래 서는 것입니다.
auto_translation: It is to stand for a long time before God, who deals with that problem.
final_translation: It is to stand for a long time before God, who deals with that problem.

stt_text: 죄책감속에서 그 안에서 머무러만 잊지 마십시오.
auto_translation: Do not remain only in that guilt. Do not forget.
final_translation: Do not remain only in that guilt. Do not forget.

auto_translation: Let the Word shine on my reality.
final_translation: Let the Word shine on my reality.

auto_translation: He is not a God who is far away.
final_translation: He is not a God who is far away.

stt_text: 우주를 지으신 분이시고, 자기 백성을 택하신 분이시고, 마침내 그 백성의 부르짖음을 들으시는 하나님이십니다.
auto_translation:
He is the One who made the universe, 
the One who chose His people, 
and at last, the God who hears the cries of His people.
final_translation:
He is the One who made the universe, 
the One who chose His people, 
and at last, the God who hears the cries of His people.
